control_reuse_contract.zero_strength_parity: synthetic tests only, exact legacy arithmetic and traces

player_context.geometry: observed same-source-image rectangles only; no court or interpolated geometry
player_context.box_validity: finite coordinates and timestamps, positive width/height, unique player ID/frame, exact six-window/source alignment; boundary-crossing rectangles remain valid
legacy_provenance_limits: Current CSV hashes freeze present artifact bytes; they do not supply the historical source-video hash missing from legacy player CSV/identity-render artifacts.
Source path/dimensions/fps/frame-count checks are copied from the prior hashed feasibility audit; selected row timestamps and window digests are freshly verified here.
Reviewed player identities do not certify manually accurate player box silhouettes or complete player coverage.
Original duplicate reconciliation provenance is retained; dropped original detector boxes are not reconstructed.
Floor coordinates are preserved as original CSV fields only. No ball projection, court transform, possession inference, or player-to-ball assignment is performed.

context_term.normalized_distance: min over all same-frame player boxes of point_box_distance / (y2-y1)
context_term.coefficient_rationale: single predeclared bounded hypothesis reusing existing score unit; not calibrated/optimized or claimed equal empirical effect
context_term.node_utility: original_confidence - context_cost; preserve signed result; no clamping
context_term.missing_boxes: neutral zero context cost with explicit context_unavailable flag
context_term.invalid_boxes: reject; do not silently treat as missing
context_term.attribution_ties: all minimizing boxes, sorted by player_id then original track_id; cost independent of row order
context_term.application: once per observed path node, using that node's own frame, after original inclusive threshold and original-order cap20

ranking_contract.score: existing path score minus summed context node costs; exact recurrence below
ranking_contract.edge_limit: distance_px <= edge_step * source_diagonal_px * elapsed_frames; elapsed_frames in [1,3]
ranking_contract.arithmetic: binary64 in existing frame/candidate/edge traversal order; when context cost equals zero node utility is original confidence; audit sums do not recompute score

matching_rule: raw center distance; uncertainty diagnostic only

review.reused_control_source_assets: bind and reuse prior native PNGs; no old re-render
